claims.text: The resort has 17 chef-led restaurants and bars.

findings.quote: 17 CHEF-LED RESTAURANTS & BARS

claims.text: The resort is all-inclusive: everything is included, from coffee, smoothies or the buffet in the morning to poolside lunch, afternoon gelato and a steakhouse dinner.

findings.quote: Everything is included, from your coffee, smoothie or buffet in the morning, to your poolside lunch, afternoon gelato and your steakhouse dinner.

claims.text: SLS Elite rooms and suites come with personal butler service and private check-in, pool and beach areas.

findings.quote: SLS Elite rooms and suites come complete with personal butler service and private check-in, pool and beach

claims.text: Coati Kids Club is a dedicated space for ages 4 to 12, with a weekly rotation of activities from arts and crafts to robot building.

findings.quote: Coati Kids Club is a dedicated space for ages 4–12, where imagination runs wild and high-energy play is encouraged, with a weekly rotation of activities from arts and crafts to robot building.

claims.text: The Teen Lounge, for ages 12 to 17, has billiards, video games and activities from Fortnite tournaments to water polo.

findings.quote: with billiards, video games and a program of activities from Fortnite tournaments to water polo. For ages 12–17
TEEN LOUNGE

findings.quote: The water playground of kids’ dreams sits alongside the family pool for endless hours of aquatic play. Slides, sprinklers and tipping buckets

claims.text: The resort has an indoor movie theatre.

findings.quote: INDOOR MOVIE THEATRE

claims.text: SLS Sculpt offers two 24/7 gyms and a schedule of group classes.

findings.quote: Two 24/7 gyms and a schedule of group classes balance the indulgence.

claims.text: Smoke & Mirrors is a bar influenced by South American speakeasies, serving spirits alongside fine cigars.

findings.quote: Smoke & Mirrors
Influenced by South American speakeasies, serving smooth liquor and spirits alongside a world-class offering of fine cigars

claims.text: Childcare is available day and night, with support from Cancun Nancy Service.

findings.quote: Available day and night, with support from the highly-experienced Cancun Nancy Service.

claims.text: Kosher dining is available through the resort's Liora program.

findings.quote: Savor exceptional kosher dining at SLS Playa Mujeres through our Liora program.

claims.text: The Envy Three Bedroom Suite has three king bedrooms with ensuites and an expansive outdoor terrace with sea views.

findings.quote: Three king bedrooms with ensuites, lavish living and dining spaces, and an expansive outdoor terrace with sea views

claims.text: Swim-out rooms are set along a winding river pool, so guests step out of the room and into the water.

findings.quote: Step out of your room and into the water, in rooms perched along a winding river pool.

claims.text: Rooftop jacuzzi rooms are bi-level, with a private rooftop deck, a jacuzzi, a lounge and panoramic sea views.

findings.quote: These bi-level rooms feature a private rooftop deck with a jacuzzi, lounge and panoramic sea views.

claims.text: Ciel Spa is a 20,000 sq ft destination spa with massages, facials, body treatments, a hydrotherapy circuit and a full-service salon.

findings.quote: A 20,000 sqft destination spa offering a curated selection of massages, facials and body treatments in addition to an immersive hydrotherapy circuit and full-service salon.

claims.text: Twiggy by La Cantine is an adults-oriented restaurant and pool club; its pool is open daily to guests over 18, with multiple jacuzzis and a central swim-up bar.

The pool is open daily to guests over 18 and features multiple jacuzzis, a central swim-up bar

findings.quote: Designed by Greg Norman, Playa Mujeres Golf is an 18-hole, par-72 masterpiece only minutes from SLS
